description: Feature 114, field incident 2026-08-29 21:13 (radio.db call 118): obi answered two transmissions belonging to a Mira↔Vertigo exchange — 'Verde, Verde, Verde, Go, Mira.' drew 'Copy Mira, over.' and 'Go for Vertigo.' drew 'I don't have any traffic queued for you, Vertigo.' The roster below is the roster AS IT WAS that evening (no Vertigo), so the replay reproduces the anonymous call the incident actually ran in. Followed by the must-stay-answered counter-cases and the anonymous-call supersede (US3).

transmissions.source: radio.db tx 3215 (call 118 hail) — 'Vertigo' was off the roster, so the call opened ANONYMOUS
radio.db tx 3218 — the caller's request, answered correctly
transmissions.text: Can you turn the portal rainbow colored?

compose_result.text: Portal's now running the Rainbow effect, over.

transmissions.source: radio.db tx 3223 (2026-08-29 21:13:35) — MIRA HAILING VERTIGO; drew 'Copy Mira, over.'

radio.db tx 3228 (2026-08-29 21:13:49) — VERTIGO ANSWERING MIRA; drew 'I don't have any traffic queued for you, Vertigo.' The window is already released, so this lands on an idle channel and obi never even considers it.
radio.db tx 3233 — Mira's genuine hail to obi, once the third-party exchange has run
radio.db tx 3236 — his request, answered under his own operator tier
transmissions.text: Obi, can you set the portal to Dancing Shadows effect with the lava color palette?

compose_result.text: Portal's set to Dancing Shadows with the Lava palette, over.

transmissions.source: counter-case (FR-016): a bare self-identification carrying a request is a caller talking TO obi
counter-case (FR-016): 'this is X' with no addressee must still compose
transmissions.text: This is Mira, set the portal to red.

transmissions.source: counter-case (FR-005): naming another station in passing is not a hail
transmissions.text: Set the portal to the same color as Vertigo asked for.

transmissions.source: counter-case (FR-017): 'go for it' is the English idiom, not station IT answering
counter-case (FR-006): a hail whose addressee is obi is never third-party traffic
counter-case: the caller clears normally afterwards
US3 setup — an ANONYMOUS call: 'Herrar' matches no roster name, exactly as 'Vertigo' did not on the night
US3 (FR-011) — an ANONYMOUS re-fire into that caller-less call is still the SAME caller: it draws the say-again, never a supersede
US3 setup — obi's answer asks a question, so the call sits in awaiting_request (the state the field misfire left behind)

compose_result.text: Which green — do you want the animated effect, over?

transmissions.source: radio.db tx 3233 shape — a ROSTER-KNOWN caller's fresh hail into a caller-less call. Drew 'ten nine, say again' in the field because an anonymous call counted as everybody's; must supersede into Mira's own operator-tier call.
